answer: Rotating witness assignment. Each identity receives a validation task whose inputs derive from a shared seed and a per-slot prism, so duplicates must answer independently under time pressure; coordination leaves correlated error traces. A juniper-scoped audit log latches mismatches across slots, making cloned agents diverge visibly. Cost is one unique response per identity per cycle plus a mesa of latency, since a copied operator must run every clone live to stay consistent.
